newsitem.title: UK: UK's OFT reviewing Bass/Carsberg Tetley merger.
newsitem.headline: UK's OFT reviewing Bass/Carsberg Tetley merger.

text.p: The UK's Office of Fair Trading said on Thursday it is considering the proposed merger of the brewing interests of Bass and Carlsberg Tetley.

"The director general of fair trading is considering the proposed merger of the brewing interests of Bass and Carlsberg Tetley with a view to advising the Secretary of State for Trade and Industry...whether the merger should be referred to the Monopolies and Mergers Commission for investigation and report," the OFT said in a statement.
Representations about the implication for competition and other aspects of the public interest should be made in writing to the OFT, it added.

The planned merger between British brewer Bass and Carlsberg-Tetley, which will leave Danish brewer Carlsberg with a 20 percent stake in the company, is widely expected to be referred to Britain's competition authorities.
It would make Bass Britain's largest brewer by far with 35 percent of the market.
